rationale: No supported optimization preserves the intended build/test coverage for this workflow. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT has measured fork evidence (26.8% elapsed savings, all successes preserved), but the example applies a 5-minute job budget; repository history shows these build jobs complete in roughly 4-10 minutes, so valid slow runs would exceed a short limit and no representative duration history exists to set a safe budget (contraindication: valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit; precondition: representative successful-duration history). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is supported only by synthetic fixtures with negligible measured job-time difference (~0.6%, elapsed not measured) and the matrix builds are cross-platform coverage, so canceling remaining cells on failure would reduce required diagnostics/coverage. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is unsafe because dependencies are fetched unpinned (git clone --depth=1 latest) and mutable.
